title: A High-Order Fast Direct Solver for Surface PDEs on Triangles
summary: We develop a triangular formulation of the hierarchical Poincaré-Steklov (HPS) method for elliptic partial differential equations on surfaces, allowing high-order discretizations on unstructured meshes and complex geometries. Classical HPS formulations rely on high-order quadrilateral meshes and tensor-product spectral discretizations, which enable efficient algorithms but restrict applicability to structured geometries.
